trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: The platinum is every other trophy in one offline playthrough, and the long part is the 100% checklist after the credits, not a second story run.

steps.t: Play the five chapters in order and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter, because there is no mission replay.
In Chapter 1, accept Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth, and do hourglass jobs such as Race Against Yago as soon as they appear.
Finish the story through The End of the Road, then use free roam. The 100% list opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and earlier progress already counts.

Clear the checklist's full requirements (robberies, vaults, gang operations, shooting-range golds, drone trials, underwater finds, Bret's decks) and the partial ones (about 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 base vehicles, 100 animals).
Finish the trophy-only leftovers: eight stranger strands, the character finales, partner crimes, and the secret pops, then the platinum should follow.

claims.t: The list is 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, all offline.
Published platinum estimates cluster around 200 hours, with the story itself closer to 60-80 hours.
There is no difficulty setting, no New Game Plus, and no mission replay; cheats turn off trophies and saving.
PlayStation tracks no separate count on this trophy; it is the set of the other 54.

Rock Paper Shotgun says a cheat blocks trophies and saving only until you reload an earlier save. Push Square agrees cheats disable trophies, and says Accessible Combat and reduced vehicle damage do not.

disputes.q: Is the platinum hidden until earned?

a.t: GamesRadar styles Vice Got a Price! as a hidden or secret award, the same way it styles the story trophies.

b.t: games.gg, Output Lag and GTABase list it among the 27 visible trophies, and GTABase's spoiler mask covers 28 others.

disputes.call: Treat it as visible. Three list pages that sort hidden from visible agree, and that split matches the 28-hidden total.

disputes.q: Is the platinum closer to 200 hours or 250?

a.t: Push Square's roadmap budgets 250 hours or more, and says the platinum means seeing almost everything.

b.t: The earlier roadmap notes cluster around 200 hours. Polygon's pre-launch report, citing Insider Gaming, also said at least 200, with a story nearer 50 hours than the 60-80 the later guides use.

disputes.call: Plan on at least 200, and treat 250 as the high published estimate. Polygon's 50-hour story figure was a pre-launch leak and sits under the post-launch ranges.

disputes.q: Does 100% completion hand you the platinum?

a.t: Eurogamer says finishing the 100% checklist is what awards the PlayStation platinum.

b.t: Push Square says 100% will likely leave some gameplay challenges still open, and the earlier platinum notes still require the stranger strands and secret pops after the checklist.

disputes.call: Do not stop at the 100% gold. Eurogamer collapses two awards. Push Square and the earlier roadmaps keep leftover trophies after the checklist.

disputes.q: Are any trophies missable?

a.t: Push Square's roadmap header says no missable trophies are known yet.

b.t: The earlier missables notes still flag Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation, and hourglass jobs such as Race Against Yago, as windows that can close.

disputes.call: Do the balcony scene and any hourglass job when it appears. Push Square had not confirmed a missable; the earlier pages name specific ones.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies in one offline playthrough; nothing online is required. [1][5][14] Plan on at least 200 hours, most of it after a 60-80 hour story. Push Square's roadmap goes to 250 or more. [1][5][22][30] Keep manual saves at chapter boundaries because there is no mission replay. Leave cheats off: Rock Paper Shotgun says they block trophies and saving until you reload, and Push Square says Accessible Combat does not. [1][11][21][30][33] Do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation and any hourglass job as soon as it appears, even though Push Square had not yet named a missable. [1][7][19][30] After The End of the Road, free roam remains and the 100% list opens under Progress > Stats. [2][12] Clearing that list is not the platinum. Eurogamer treats 100% as the platinum, but Push Square still leaves gameplay challenges, and the stranger strands and secret pops come after the checklist. [1][5][27][30]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.summary: This pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first Chapter 1 mission after the prologue, and it cannot be skipped if you play the story.

steps.t: Finish the prologue stick-up, then start Chapter 1 when the Just Like Paradise title card appears.
Play Gone Fishing as Jason: the boat run in the Keys, the Kingfishers camp, and the flight out.
The bronze should unlock when that mission ends. It is the first story trophy and is not optional.

Ease off at each of the three water drops so Cal can hook the package, free Donnie from the shack by the camp's west turbine, then fly the seaplane into Brian's marina. The bronze pops after you drive Cal home and go inside, not at the landing.

claims.t: Gone Fishing is the first main mission of Chapter 1, after a separate prologue.
The trophy is hidden on PlayStation until earned.
It is story-locked and cannot be missed if you continue the campaign.
Push Square and Fextralife both treat it as a story unlock and leave the published line as Complete Gone Fishing.

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening Chapter 1 mission after the prologue. [3][17][21] The bronze is hidden until it pops, and it cannot be missed if you keep playing the story. [1][11][25]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.summary: Chapter 1 ends in the Tourist Trap run through Discharge Time, and this bronze is reported to pop as Chapter 2 starts rather than on the last cutscene.

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 through to Tourist Trap. That mission locks free roam and runs straight into Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time.
Before you start Tourist Trap, bank cash you care about and do the balcony meditation, because the house and carried money are lost.
Continue into Chapter 2. The chapter bronze is reported to unlock once What's in the Bag?, the first Chapter 2 mission, is done.
Eurogamer's locked ending is Tourist Trap, then Home Sweet Home as Lucia, then Discharge Time out of the hospital, with no free-roam break in that stretch.

claims.t: MyGTA titles Chapter 1 Just Like Paradise and Chapter 2 Paradise Lost, which matches this trophy name landing at the chapter change.
PowerPyx and GTABase say the bronze unlocks after What's in the Bag?, not on Discharge Time itself.
Starting Tourist Trap is a point of no return: Jason's house and carried cash are lost.
The trophy is hidden.
MetaForge says starting Tourist Trap also deletes the Chapter 1 side jobs, not only the house and the cash you are carrying, so a separate save is the only way back.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The last stretch, Tourist Trap through Discharge Time, takes the house and the cash you are carrying, so bank money and do the balcony meditation first. [19][21] The bronze is hidden and is reported to pop after What's in the Bag?, the first mission of Chapter 2. [1][25]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.summary: Chapter 2 closes when you leave the Starlet Motel in Checking Out, and the bronze is reported to pop as Welcome to Vice City begins Chapter 3.

steps.t: Work through Chapter 2, including Moses, Daily Driver, Breakfast Run and Coffee Break, which is when free switching between Jason and Lucia opens.
Checking Out ends the chapter and removes the Starlet Motel as a safehouse, so use it before you leave.
Start Chapter 3. PowerPyx and GTABase say the bronze unlocks after Welcome to Vice City.
Before Checking Out, Eurogamer's Coffee Break objectives ask you to bank $15,000 for the move and move $100,000 into family savings.

claims.t: The official name keeps the asterisks; it is not spelled out on the trophy list.
Chapter 2's last main mission on the walkthrough lists is Checking Out.
The bronze is hidden and is tied to the start of Chapter 3 rather than the motel cutscene alone.
Fextralife and Rock Paper Shotgun both print the name with the asterisks and the description Complete Chapter 2.

disputes.q: Is Welcome to Vice City the last job of Chapter 2 or the first of Chapter 3?

a.t: Eurogamer's walkthrough table still files Welcome to Vice City under Chapter 2, right after Checking Out.

b.t: MetaForge opens Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City, and the earlier mission lists close Chapter 2 on Checking Out.

disputes.call: Treat Checking Out as the chapter end. Eurogamer's table stops at that handover and has not been extended, while MetaForge and the older lists agree on the split.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2, which the mission lists close with Checking Out and the loss of the Starlet Motel safehouse. [3][19][21] The hidden bronze is reported to pop after Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3. [1][25] The published name keeps the asterisks. [9][13]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.summary: Chapter 3 is the Vice City stretch that ends in The Cartel Heist, and this bronze is reported to wait until the first two missions of Chapter 4.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3 through the Cartel Heist chain, ending on the heist itself.
While you are here, do Race Against Yago if the hourglass is up, and Yasmani's jewelry jobs if you want the Snap Gun early.
Continue into Chapter 4. PowerPyx and GTABase say the bronze unlocks after Ocean Beach and Another Life.

claims.t: MyGTA titles Chapter 3 with this trophy's name, written out, and Chapter 4 as Vice City, Baby.
PowerPyx and GTABase place the unlock after the first two Chapter 4 missions, not on the heist cutscene.
Output Lag says chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, whose last story beat on the walkthrough lists is The Cartel Heist. [3][17] The hidden bronze is reported to pop after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the opening pair of Chapter 4. [1][11][25]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.summary: Chapter 4 closes on Starting From Zero, and this bronze is the chapter clear, not the story's last mission.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 through Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and the closing missions.
Do the optional That's Where The Money Is while it is marked if you want bank vaults unlocked before the chapter ends.
Finish Starting From Zero. PowerPyx ties this bronze to that mission.
MetaForge ends Chapter 4 on Starting From Zero and starts Chapter 5 as a separate ten-mission list, so this bronze is not the last story pop.

claims.t: Walkthrough lists put Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4, with Chapter 5 still to come.
MyGTA titles Chapter 5 Top of the World, Ma, so the chapter bronze may surface as that chapter begins.
The trophy is hidden.
Push Square, Fextralife and Rock Paper Shotgun all keep the published description as Complete Chapter 4 and file the unlock as part of the story.

disputes.q: Does this bronze share an unlock with the gold final-mission trophy?

a.t: PowerPyx's trophy page says both this bronze and You Gotta Know When to Get Off unlock after Starting From Zero.

b.t: Output Lag says the gold pops on the Story Complete screen after The End of the Road, a Chapter 5 mission, and the walkthrough lists keep Starting From Zero in Chapter 4.

disputes.call: Treat this bronze as the Chapter 4 clear. Do not assume the gold has popped just because this one has.

disputes.q: Does Rock Paper Shotgun's Chapter 5 wording make this bronze the gold finale?

a.t: Rock Paper Shotgun prints You Gotta Know When to Get Off as Complete Chapter 5, which would fold the finale into a chapter clear.

b.t: Fextralife and Push Square keep that gold as Complete the final mission, and MetaForge still lists ten Chapter 5 missions after Starting From Zero.

disputes.call: Do not stop when this bronze pops. The Chapter 5 line on the Rock Paper Shotgun list does not match the other published descriptions.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The walkthrough lists close it with Starting From Zero, and Chapter 5 is still ahead. [3][17] The bronze is hidden. [11][25] PowerPyx also ties the gold finale trophy to that same mission, but the endings guide and the mission lists put the real finale later, so do not stop here. [1][12]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.summary: The gold is the story finale, The End of the Road, and it is reported to pop on the Story Complete screen after the credits, not on a mission-select replay.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 5 up to the finale marker. Make a fresh manual save before you start The End of the Road.
Play the mission through the bridge roadblock. The prompt is Swim for it or No Surrender; either path still completes the story.
Watch the credits and the post-credits scene. Output Lag says the gold pops on the Story Complete screen.
Choose Continue. You are put back in free roam before the finale, with side content still available.

claims.t: The End of the Road is the last listed story mission and starts at Cal's place in the Keys.
After the credits the game returns you to before the finale so you can still chase 100%.
The gold is hidden and is worth 50 Gamerscore on Xbox.
No trophy depends on which ending prompt you pick.

disputes.q: Which mission is the final mission this gold tracks?

a.t: PowerPyx's trophy page says it unlocks after Chapter 4's Starting From Zero, the same line it uses for Top Of The World, Ma.

b.t: Output Lag, checked against finale playthroughs, says it pops on the Story Complete screen after The End of the Road. PowerPyx's own mission list and MyGTA put that mission at the end of Chapter 5.

disputes.call: Play through The End of the Road and the credits. If the gold already popped at Starting From Zero, you are done; if not, the endings page is the one that matches the mission order.

trophies.guide: Complete the last story mission. The mission lists end on The End of the Road in Chapter 5, and Output Lag says the hidden gold pops on the Story Complete screen after the credits. [12][17] Save in a fresh slot first, because there is no mission replay, then either roadblock prompt still finishes the story. [11][12] PowerPyx's trophy page instead ties this gold to Starting From Zero; treat that as the Chapter 4 bronze unless the gold has already popped. [1][3] Continue returns you to free roam before the finale. [12][22]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.summary: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission, played while checking on Jason, and the bronze pops as part of that mission.

steps.t: Advance Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run is on the map, listed as Check on Jason.
Play it through. It sits just before Coffee Break on the mission lists.
The hidden bronze unlocks during the mission and cannot be skipped if you are finishing the chapter.
Eurogamer describes the job as a shared breakfast that turns into a long run of robberies, not a short check-in on Jason.

claims.t: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission, not a stranger strand.
Output Lag says character switching opens right after this mission; Leonidex and PowerPyx name the following mission, Coffee Break.
The trophy is hidden.
MetaForge slots Breakfast Run as Chapter 2 mission 14, immediately before Coffee Break, and Push Square still files the bronze as a plain story unlock.

trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run, the Chapter 2 mission marked Check on Jason. [1][3] It sits just before Coffee Break, and the hidden bronze pops as you play it. [1][17][25]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.summary: The Cartel Heist is the Chapter 3 story heist, and this bronze pops when that mission chain is finished.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, follow the Cartel Heist steps: scope Sinfrontera National Bank, the planning missions, then the heist itself.
Play the heist when Raul's contact puts it on the map. It is a required story mission.
The hidden bronze unlocks during the mission.
MetaForge breaks the story heist into a Sinfrontera scope, a practice safe, explosives prep, and only then a start-the-heist marker.

claims.t: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission, late in that chapter.
It is separate from the later free-roam bank-vault robberies, which unlock in Chapter 4.
The trophy is hidden.
Fextralife keeps the description as Complete The Cartel Heist, and Rock Paper Shotgun treats the 22 later bank jobs as a separate 100% line that opens after Credit Check.

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the Chapter 3 story job built around Sinfrontera National Bank. [1][3][17] It is not the same as the later vault robberies. [1][2] The bronze is hidden and pops as you complete the mission. [1][25]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.summary: Child's Play is the Chapter 4 rescue mission, and the bronze pops when you finish it.

steps.t: In Chapter 4, follow the Jason-side lead through Rafa's kidnapping until Child's Play is available.
Play Child's Play, marked as rescuing Rafa from the kidnappers.
The hidden bronze unlocks during that mission.
On MetaForge's Chapter 4 list, Child's Play follows the Jason-only kidnapping marker and comes before the airport heist is allowed to start.

claims.t: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission.
The trophy is hidden.
It is unmissable if you finish the chapter.
Rock Paper Shotgun rates it a hidden 15 G bronze, the same band as Headliners, and Fextralife keeps the description Complete Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, the Chapter 4 mission to rescue Rafa. [1][3] The bronze is hidden and pops as the mission ends. [1][11][25]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.summary: Headliners is the Chapter 4 launch-party mission, and this bronze pops when you complete it.

steps.t: Advance the Chapter 4 party and security jobs until Headliners is marked.
Play Headliners, the launch-party job.
The hidden bronze unlocks during the mission.
MetaForge places Headliners after the launch-party security work and before the airport heist marker, so finish the party job even if the heist prep is already done.

claims.t: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission, separate from VCIA Takedown.
The trophy is hidden.
It cannot be skipped if you are completing Chapter 4.
Push Square files it as a story unlock, and both Fextralife and Rock Paper Shotgun keep the published description Complete Headliners.

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, the Chapter 4 launch-party mission. [1][3] The bronze is hidden and pops during that job. [1][25]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.summary: VCIA Takedown is the Chapter 4 airport heist, and the bronze pops when that story mission is done, not when you later steal a parked jet.

steps.t: Work the VCIA Takedown prep missions in Chapter 4, split between Jason and Lucia.
Start the airport heist when the plans are in place.
Finish the mission. The hidden bronze unlocks during it.
MetaForge's prep chain includes an airport scope, a stolen catering truck and bodybuilder surveillance before the VCIA Takedown start marker appears.

claims.t: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission, not the free-roam plane theft.
The free-roam jet theft is a different trophy, Catch Me If You Can.
The trophy is hidden.
TheGamer says Vice City International is no longer an instant five-star zone if you stay out of security's way. Rock Paper Shotgun still lists this bronze separately from the free-roam jet theft.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, the Chapter 4 airport heist. [1][3] Stealing a jet from a boarding bridge later is a different bronze. [1][11] This one is hidden and pops during the mission. [1][25]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.summary: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission, before the finale, and the bronze pops when you complete it.

steps.t: Start Chapter 5 after Starting From Zero and play through to Operation Savage Glory.
Complete that mission. It is not the last mission of the game.
The hidden bronze unlocks during the mission.
MetaForge puts Operation Savage Glory fifth in a ten-mission Chapter 5, with Protective Custody and The End of the Road still after it.

claims.t: Operation Savage Glory sits in Chapter 5, ahead of Protective Custody and The End of the Road.
The trophy is hidden.
It is a required story mission, so it is not a free-roam cleanup item.
Rock Paper Shotgun lists it as a hidden 25 G bronze, the same Gamerscore band as Hi-Jacked and Break the Bank, and Fextralife keeps the description Complete Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission that comes before the finale. [1][3][17] The bronze is hidden and pops as you complete it. [1][25]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.summary: This gold is the in-game 100% checklist, which opens after the story and asks for every robbery type plus only a share of most collectibles.

steps.t: Finish the story. Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Work you did earlier already counts.
Clear the all-or-nothing lines: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 vaults, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone trials, and Bret's 15 target decks.

Stop the partial lines once you hit the checklist number: 100 optional tasks, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 of 125 flamingos, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Nothing on that list is missable after the credits, so leftover chapter jobs can wait for free roam.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks this trophy out of 100.
The checklist is closer to a partial clear than a true 100% of every side quest.
KeenGamer budgets about 100 hours for the post-story checklist pass.
Story completion is weighted far above a single collectible category on IGN's table, which gives the story 50% of the score.

disputes.q: How many stick-ups, marked bills and challenges does 100% actually want?

a.t: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say 50 of 91 stick-ups, $250,000 marked bills fenced, and 70 of 80 challenges. PlayStationTrophies instead says 80 of 90 challenges.

b.t: IGN's table shows stick-ups as X/100, marked bills as $100,000, and says every optional mission is required. That page also says the totals are still being filled in.

disputes.call: Follow the in-game checklist. Where guides already agree, use 50 stick-ups, $250,000 marked bills and 70 of 80 challenges, and treat IGN's unfinished table as the outlier.

disputes.q: Is the vehicle target 200 of 277 or 200 of 557?

a.t: PowerPyx's 100% intro says scan any 200 of 557 vehicles.

b.t: The same page's checklist, plus KeenGamer and MyGTA, say 200 of 277 base models. PowerPyx later says 280 standout vehicles do not count.

disputes.call: Scan base models until the checklist reads 200 of 277. The 557 figure is the two pools added together.

disputes.q: Does 100% want every collectible set, or only a share?

a.t: Eurogamer's table marks card sets, Kenton sets, magazines, meditation spots, cocaine flamingos and unique races as All, and it prints both golf locations plus $100,000 in marked bills.

b.t: Rock Paper Shotgun prints partial caps instead, including 15 of 18 card sets, 5 of 7 Kenton sets, 30 of 34 magazines, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 flamingos and $250,000 marked bills. Push Square agrees on the 15-of-18 card cap, and PowerPyx already used that card cap, the flamingo cap and the $250,000 figure.

disputes.call: Use the partial caps. Eurogamer's All column matches the unfinished tables more than the checklists that print denominators, and the in-game list is the tie-break.

trophies.guide: Reach the in-game 100% checklist, which opens after the story under Progress > Stats and already includes earlier work. [1][2][23] PlayStation tracks it out of 100. [13] You need every gang operation, bank job, payday loan, vault, underwater discovery, shooting-range gold, drone trial and Bret deck, but only a share of cards, stunts, challenges, vehicles and animals. [2][5][25] Ignore IGN's unfinished stick-up and marked-bill figures where they disagree, and scan 200 of 277 base vehicles, not 557. [2][16][23] Budget about 100 hours after the credits. [5]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.summary: Any 250 unique stunts count, mixed across jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, and 100% still wants 50 more.

steps.t: Open the map's Exploration filter and look under Stunt Spots. Each spot has a unique name and stays marked once found.
Mix the four types. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest bulk, then stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps.
Doing the stunt once is enough. The extra challenge on the map icon is not required.
Stop at 250 for this silver, then keep going to 300 if you are chasing A Long Road.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 250. The world total given by the guides is 397: 130 jumps, 202 bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
100% wants 300 of those 397.
The silver is visible from the start.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts, any mix of the 397. [1][13] The split reported is 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and flying under bridges is the quickest bulk. [1][2][22] One successful attempt counts; the optional challenge on the icon does not. [1] 100% still wants 300, so do not stop if you are on the gold. [2][14]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.summary: PlayStation counts nine activity types, and trying each one once is enough, even if several races are bundled as a single type.

steps.t: Open Progress, then Activities, and see which of the nine still read zero.
Cover fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, one made basketball, one video game, one won race or drone race, and one stunt.
A single attempt is enough for each type. You do not need a medal.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks this out of 9.
PowerPyx's nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a won race or drone race, and a stunt.
PlayStationTrophies notes the game bundles several race categories into one of those nine.
The trophy is visible.

trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. PlayStation tracks 9. [9][13] PowerPyx lists fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a made basket, a video game, a won race or drone race, and a stunt. [1] Races are bundled, so one win covers that slot. [22] Check Progress > Activities if one is still empty. [1]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.summary: Gold every difficulty of the 12 courses at the two ranges, which adds up to 42 golds and is also required for 100%.

steps.t: Buy the $5 waiver at Griffin, northwest of Vice City, and at Rodgers Ranch, northeast of Port Gellhorn. Courses then mark on the map.
At Griffin, gold the three difficulties on each of the six moving courses. Lucia is the faster runner for those.
At Rodgers, gold the four difficulties on each of the six point courses. Build the multiplier with body shots before the headshot, and do not miss.
Rent the course weapon for $10 if you do not own it. Rentals are enough for gold.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 42 golds. Griffin accounts for 18 and Rodgers Ranch for 24.
All 42 are required for 100% as well as for this silver.
Finishing or quitting a course also raises Focus.
The silver is visible.

trophies.guide: Gold every shooting-range difficulty: 18 at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch, 42 in all. [4][13][24] Buy the $5 waiver at each counter, play Lucia on the moving Griffin courses, and build multipliers on the stationary Rodgers courses. [4][24] A $10 rental gun is enough. [4] The same 42 are required for 100%. [2][5]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.summary: Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun sites. 100% is stricter and wants all 42 time trials.

steps.t: Unfog the map and filter Activities for Top Fun Drones. Icons appear when you get within about 100 meters.
At each of the 14 sites, win one race. That is all this bronze asks for.
If you are also on 100%, beat the par time on the first two trials at a site to open the third, then finish all 42.
Hold the stick forward and avoid crashes. PlayStationTrophies calls the drone trials one of the skill walls.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 14 locations, not 42 races.
Each location has three time trials, 42 in all, and 100% wants every trial.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. PlayStation tracks 14. [9][13] Icons show up once you are close, under the Activities filter. [2] 100% wants all 42 trials, and you must beat par on the first two at a site to open the third. [2][5] The trials are one of the few skill checks on the list. [22]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.summary: Win 20 different races. That is below the 30 unique wins 100% wants, so the bronze should pop before the checklist is done.

steps.t: Filter the map for Activities, then Racing. Race icons appear when you get within about 100 meters.
Win 20 different races. Repeating one course does not add a new win.
If you are on 100%, keep going to 30 of the 40 unique races. You can skip the hardest 10.
Race-challenge golds are a separate 100% line. This bronze only needs race wins.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 20 different races.
There are 40 unique races, and 100% wants 30 wins.
There are also 13 race challenges; 100% wants gold on 10 of them, which is not this trophy.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PlayStation tracks 20. [13] Race icons show up when you are close, under the Activities filter. [2] 100% wants 30 of 40 unique wins, so this bronze should pop first. [2][5] Race-challenge golds are a separate checklist line. [2]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.summary: After Feng Shui, beat Cal by landing a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb at his marked spot in Gambit Bay.

steps.t: Finish Feng Shui in Chapter 1, then read Cal's text. A purple fishing marker appears in Gambit Bay, west of Key Lento.
Take a boat, drop anchor, and use the small saltwater lure you start with. Focus highlights fish in the water.
Hook a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb, then send the result to Cal from the catch screen.
A free rod is on the dock behind Jason's house if you do not have one yet. You do not have to wait for the Recalibration tutorial.

claims.t: Cal's challenge opens after Feng Shui, which is a Chapter 1 mission.
The target KeenGamer names is a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb in Gambit Bay.
Fishing is catch-and-release and also raises Focus.
The bronze is visible, and it is one of the earlier non-story pops.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal's fishing challenge after Feng Shui. [1][8] His marker is in Gambit Bay. Land a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb with the starter saltwater lure and send him the catch. [8] A free rod is on the dock behind Jason's house, and you can fish before the later tutorial. [8] The bronze is visible. [11][14]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.summary: Finish every level of one of the four video games. Starting a game is enough for the 100% line, but this bronze wants a full clear.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, interact with the controllers by the TV at home. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind can be played there.
Clear every level of one game. You do not need that game's extra challenges.
If the home set is locked, which happens for much of Chapter 2, use a Bang For Your Buck cabinet in the world, or wait until Chapter 3.
For 100%, start all four games. Quitting immediately still counts on that checklist line.

claims.t: PowerPyx names four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck.
The home console is unavailable for much of Chapter 2 and returns from Chapter 3.
Output Lag says any of the four counts once completed. PowerPyx says you must reach the end of one game, not merely start it.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Finish one of the four video games, not just start it. [1][11] Three are on the home TV in Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on cabinets in the world. [1] The home set is locked for much of Chapter 2. [1][2][19] 100% only needs you to start all four. [2]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.summary: Andy's five-mission Lucia-only strand ends on Puff Puff Pass, and it is still available after the story.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, as Lucia, take Andy's call. Her home marks in Belville.
Play the strand as Lucia only: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.
The hidden bronze pops on the last mission. The strand does not count as one of the eight stranger strands.

claims.t: Andy is Lucia-only and starts from a Chapter 3 phone call.
PowerPyx lists five missions, ending on Puff Puff Pass.
The strand stays available after the credits.
The trophy is hidden, and the strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission, Puff Puff Pass, as Lucia. [1][18] The strand starts from her Chapter 3 call in Belville and runs five jobs. [1][3] It stays available after the story and does not count as a stranger strand. [1][11][18] The bronze is hidden. [14]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.summary: Kenton's diving strand is seven shipwreck sets. He vanishes after Chapter 1, then comes back, so the finale is not lost if you leave the Keys.

steps.t: Play Island Dreams in Chapter 1, then wait for Kenton's call. His shop marks with a green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the purple wreck markers, use the metal detector on the seabed, and turn each set in.
He goes quiet after Chapter 1. Keep playing; he texts again in Chapter 2 or 3, or you can call Brian as Jason to speed that up.
Clear all seven wreck sets. Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. 100% only needs five sets, but the underwater line needs all 33 discoveries.

claims.t: Kenton wants seven shipwreck sets. 100% needs five of those sets, but all 33 underwater discoveries.
He is unavailable for a stretch after Chapter 1 and returns later, including after the story.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last treasure set. He marks seven wrecks after Island Dreams, from his shop in Key Lento. [1][2][21] He disappears after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so the strand is not lost. [1][19] 100% only needs five sets, but this bronze and the 33 underwater finds want the full run. [1][2] The trophy is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.summary: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break and end on Hometown Heroes, still available after the story.

steps.t: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and start Thrillbillies.
Play Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, then Mall Rats, which is marked solo-only.
Steal the Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes. That last job pops the hidden bronze.
The strand does not count toward the eight stranger strands.

claims.t: Billy's strand starts after Coffee Break at the mud club in Kelly County.
PowerPyx lists five missions, ending on Hometown Heroes.
It stays available after the story and does not count as a stranger strand.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last job, Hometown Heroes. [1] The strand starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break and runs five missions, including a solo Mall Rats. [1][3] It stays open after the credits and is not a stranger strand. [1][11][18] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.window: Race Against Yago is an hourglass job in Chapter 3. Missing it can end Yago's strand. Other counting strands remain, so the silver itself may still be reachable.
trophies.summary: Only some open-world strands count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Andy, Billy and Tyrone have their own trophies and do not.

steps.t: Finish Kirk's night strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, the tree effigies, then Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove as Lucia at night.
Finish Kyle: McKittrick Farm, the chemicals, then Buddy?.
Do Yago's street-race strand the moment Race Against Yago shows an hourglass, then finish Brother to Brother.
Finish Pilot Pete's delivery strand, which is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 4.
Check the trophy counter after each finale. Moses, Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Yasmani and Eddie do not move it.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 8 strands.
PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and says more strands are still being found.
Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count, because they have their own bronzes.
The silver is visible, and the counting strands that are not marked missable remain after the story.

disputes.q: Can failing an hourglass job lock this silver?

a.t: PowerPyx says hourglass jobs fail if you wait, but that those failures do not affect trophies, and that stranger strands remain after the story.

b.t: Output Lag and MyGTA say Race Against Yago is timed, counts toward this silver, and can lock the rest of Yago's line if it expires.

disputes.call: Do Race Against Yago immediately. Even if PowerPyx is right that the silver survives, you should not spend a confirmed strand.

trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands. PlayStation tracks 8. [13] Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not. [1][18] Do Race Against Yago as soon as the hourglass appears, because Output Lag and MyGTA say missing it can kill that strand, even though PowerPyx says hourglass failures do not touch trophies. [1][11][19] Check the trophy counter after each finale. [1][14]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.summary: After you steal the Zorrusso for Randy, deliver the rest of his 16-car wish list. That finale is still available after the story.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3. That mission gives the key cloner and the first Zorrusso delivery.
Open Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars; others can be stolen off the street once a WAiNK scan says he wants them.
Deliver them to the green RK marker in west Vice City. Better condition pays more, and sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
The hidden bronze pops when the list is finished. His payouts also cover a large share of the $200,000 vehicles-fenced line.

claims.t: Randy's list is 16 sports cars, and the Zorrusso from the story mission is the first.
The strand stays available after the story.
MyGTA notes one guide files the list under Chapter 4 rather than Chapter 3.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. [1][3] He wants 16 sports cars, delivered to his garage in west Vice City, and the list stays open after the story. [1][11] Clean deliveries pay more and feed the vehicles-fenced checklist line. [1][2] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.summary: Tyrone's Jason-only strand is destroying Kitty Litter labs, and the bronze pops on the follow-up job Spin On This.

steps.t: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, play as Jason. Lucia cannot take the strand.
Destroy the purple synthetic-lab markers for Take Out Kitty Litter.
When Tyrone offers Spin On This, finish that job. The hidden bronze pops there.
The strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, and it remains after the story.

claims.t: Tyrone is Jason-only and starts after Here, Kitty Kitty.
Each lab also counts as an optional task on the 100% list.
Tyrone later pays the highest fence price for narcotics, from Chapter 3, in La Perle.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last job, Spin On This, as Jason. [1][18] Destroy the Kitty Litter labs he marks after Here, Kitty Kitty, then take the follow-up. [1][2] The strand stays open after the story and is not a stranger strand. [1][11] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.window: The morning after Down to Earth, Lucia invites Jason to meditate on the balcony. That scene ends with Chapter 1. Guides disagree on whether it is one of the 18 PlayStation counts.
trophies.summary: PlayStation wants 18 meditations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony scene anyway, then both characters at the free-roam seats, and the summit spot last.

steps.t: The morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept. Save first.
After Coffee Break, call your partner and meditate at each outdoor seat as both Jason and Lucia. Purple icons appear when you are close.
KeenGamer's route is Smooth Sand, the Kelly County trio, the Lummox County trio, then Seaside east of Waning Sands.
When the other sessions are done, a new icon appears at the stone circle on Mount Kalaga. That session is the last one on KeenGamer's count.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 18.
100% only needs 15 of 18, so a missed balcony scene does not block A Long Road.
KeenGamer splits the 18 as one balcony session, 16 from eight seats with both characters, and one summit session.
The bronze is visible, and it is the only trophy the roadmap pages flag as potentially missable.

disputes.q: Does the Chapter 1 balcony session count toward the 18?

a.t: PowerPyx says the balcony session adds 1 in the Progress menu but is not marked like the other spots, and that it is still unclear whether the trophy needs it. The author had done it when the trophy popped.

b.t: KeenGamer counts it as meditation 1 of 18, and MyGTA's missables page says it counts toward the trophy and is gone after Chapter 1.

disputes.call: Accept the balcony invite. It costs one morning, and skipping it is the only way this bronze might lock.

trophies.guide: Meditate until PlayStation's counter hits 18. [9][13] Accept Lucia's balcony invite the morning after Down to Earth, before Chapter 1 ends. [1][7][9] KeenGamer counts that session, eight seats done by both characters, and a final summit circle on Mount Kalaga that appears only after the rest. [7] PowerPyx is not sure the balcony session is required, but 100% only needs 15, so the risk is this bronze, not A Long Road. [1][2] Do the balcony scene anyway. [7][19]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.summary: Bret's Jason-only hunting decks start after Coffee Break, and one unique animal on that list pops the bronze. Which animal is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: As Jason, after Coffee Break, answer Bret Vogel's text and meet him in Lummox County. Lucia does not get the message.
Take the Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation locker and hunt the purple target-deck markers.
A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more. Bring the animal back to Bret as Jason.
100% wants all 15 decks, so this bronze should pop along the way. PowerPyx has not pinned which animal is the unique one.

claims.t: There are 15 target decks, all required for 100%.
The strand is Jason-only and remains after the story.
Studying 100 animals with binoculars is a separate 100% line and does not replace the hunt.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Meet him as Jason after Coffee Break, then work his target decks. [1][2] A clean head or heart shot pays more. [2][11] All 15 decks are required for 100%, so the hidden bronze should pop during that run, though PowerPyx has not named the exact animal. [1][2][5]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.summary: Finish any 3 of the 18 card sets. 100% wants 15, so this silver is an early stop on a longer collect.

steps.t: Pick up cards indoors on surfaces and outdoors in phone boxes and tool boxes. Track sets under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
Finish three complete sets. Duplicates can be sold at a pawn shop without losing the card you already logged.
Keep going to 15 of 18 sets if you want A Long Road. You do not need every card in the game.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 3 sets. The world total given by the guides is 18 sets and 480 cards.
100% wants 15 of 18 sets.
MyGTA says set sizes disagree between guides, and that only Vice City Flamingos at 24 cards is agreed by two outlets.
The silver is visible.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible-card sets. PlayStation tracks 3. [13] There are 18 sets and 480 cards, and 100% wants 15 sets, so this silver pops early. [2][5][16] Duplicates can be sold without losing a logged card. [16] Set sizes are not agreed beyond Vice City Flamingos at 24, so use the in-game set tracker. [16]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.summary: Scan 100 environmental WAiNK spots on foot. Vehicle scans are a different counter.

steps.t: On foot, hold up on the d-pad and R1 when the nearby-scan prompt appears. You cannot scan these from a vehicle.
Any 100 locations count. PowerPyx groups them as landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Track the total under Progress, Collections, Waink Locations. The same 100 is the 100% line.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 100 location scans.
PowerPyx lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, and says there are more than 100.
MyGTA says one guide totals 112 scans, including 23 No Flusher tags, but that total is not on PowerPyx's trophy page.
Vehicle scans do not fill this counter.
The silver is visible.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations on foot. PlayStation tracks 100. [1][13] Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100. [1] Vehicle scans are a separate objective. [14][16] The same 100 is what 100% asks for. [2][5]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.summary: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. 100% wants 70, so this bronze should pop on the way and you can skip the hardest 10.

steps.t: Open Progress, then Challenges, and read the Completed mark on each one.
Leave this until other trophies are done. Many challenges complete themselves while you rob, race and explore.
Pick the shortest remaining ones until you hit 50. There are 8 categories of 10, all available from the start.
For A Long Road, continue to 70 and skip the 10 worst.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 50. The guide total is 80 challenges.
PowerPyx, KeenGamer and IGN say 100% wants 70 of 80.
PlayStationTrophies instead says 80 of 90 challenges.
The bronze is visible.

disputes.q: Are there 80 challenges or 90?

a.t: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and IGN say 80 challenges, with 70 needed for 100% and 50 for this bronze.

b.t: PlayStationTrophies says the 100% line is 80 of 90 challenges.

disputes.call: Use the in-game Challenges menu. Until that menu shows 90, plan on 80 and stop this bronze at 50.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. PlayStation tracks 50, and the detailed checklists say there are 80. [1][2][13] Many finish themselves while you play, so do this late and skip the slow ones. [1][5] 100% wants 70 on those same pages. PlayStationTrophies says 80 of 90 instead, so trust the in-game list if the totals disagree. [5][22][23]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.summary: Once you can call your partner, drop a 4-star wanted level with them in the car and leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

steps.t: Wait until you can call your partner. Leonidex and PowerPyx put that on Coffee Break; Output Lag says it opens right after Breakfast Run.
Get four stars with your partner still with you. A large-bank vault robbery does this instantly once that job is unlocked.
Escape until the red heat zone is gone. Clearing only the flashing search ring is not enough.
games.gg suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as cover from the helicopter.

claims.t: The bronze is visible and has no PlayStation progress counter.
Vault robberies give four stars immediately, so they can pop this trophy and Maximum Withdrawal together.
The pop is delayed until you leave the red heat zone.

disputes.q: When can you first bring a partner along?

a.t: PowerPyx and Leonidex say free switching, and playing together, opens at Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

b.t: Output Lag says switching opens right after Breakfast Run, the mission immediately before Coffee Break.

disputes.call: If the partner call is missing after Breakfast Run, finish Coffee Break and try again.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and get out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search ring. [11][14] You can call them from Coffee Break, or possibly right after Breakfast Run. [1][11][21] A bank-vault robbery hands you four stars immediately. [1][14] The bronze is visible. [14]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.summary: With your partner called in, rob three shops while the stars stay up. Dropping to a red heat zone with no stars breaks the chain.

steps.t: Call your partner after Coffee Break, or right after Breakfast Run if the call is already there.
Stick up three shops in a row without letting the wanted stars fade. A red heat zone alone does not keep the chain.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop. The pop is delayed.
A solid red star means the chase is already over and units still have your description. A new stick-up in that state restores the old stars, so do not treat a red heat wash as the chain.

claims.t: The chain breaks if the stars drop, even if you are still in the red heat zone.
The unlock can take about 30 seconds after the third shop.
The bronze is visible.
Rock Paper Shotgun lists it as a visible 20 G bronze, and Fextralife separates an active white-star chase from the red heat that lingers after the stars drop.

trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while the wanted stars stay up. [11][14] A red heat zone without stars does not count. [14] Wait half a minute after the third shop before you assume it failed. [11][14] You need the partner call, which opens around Breakfast Run and Coffee Break. [11][21]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.summary: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app. 100% wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this bronze.

steps.t: Hold up on the d-pad to open WAiNK, then R1, and scan traffic, boats and aircraft as you travel.
Different regions spawn different models. Ocean Beach has supercars, Port Gellhorn has vans and trucks, Key Lento has everyday cars.
Stop at 100 for this bronze. Continue to 200 base models for 100%. Standout vehicles in fixed spots do not fill that line.

Open WAiNK on the phone and hold R1 to highlight a vehicle. Lock, alarm, tracker and sale value show before the engine is on, and the vehicle hub treats that scan as the way to read a car before you keep it.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 100 discoveries.
100% wants 200 of 277 base models. PowerPyx says 280 standout vehicles do not count.
The bronze is visible.
Rock Paper Shotgun's checklist still wants 200 of 277 base models after this bronze's 100. Eurogamer's shorter table prints only the 200 target and does not mention the 277 pool.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. PlayStation tracks 100. [1][13] Keep going to 200 of 277 base models for 100%, and skip the 280 standout cars. [2][5][16] Scan boats and aircraft too. [1]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.summary: In one Combat Focus, down five enemies. Gang guards work; soldiers, police and civilians do not, according to PowerPyx.

steps.t: Raise Focus first: eat, wash, or use adrenaline from the weapon wheel so the slow-motion window lasts longer.
Aim a firearm and press L3 and R3 together. Line up a cluster of gang guards, such as an illegal operation.
Use a full-auto rifle, wear armor, and do not miss. PowerPyx says the trophy does not count soldiers, police or civilians.
Focus also rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots at a psycho profile, so later attempts are easier.

claims.t: Combat Focus is L3 plus R3 while aiming, and it drains the purple bar.
PowerPyx says police, soldiers and civilians do not count.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Down five enemies in one Combat Focus. Aim and press both sticks. [1][14] Buff the purple bar first, use a full-auto rifle, and pick gang guards rather than police or civilians. [1][11] Shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing all lengthen Focus. [1][7]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.summary: Steal a passenger jet that is docked to a boarding bridge at Vice City International, take off, and fly about a kilometre away.

steps.t: Save, then enter the airfield. Planes parked out on the apron do not count.
Use the jet at gates E3 and E4. Stairs by the boarding bridge lead into the plane.
Go upstairs, reverse off the bridge, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport. The pop is delayed.
Do not substitute a Mile Zero fighter. Those jets sit on the military runway and pull a five-star wanted level, which is a different theft from a docked airliner.

claims.t: The jet has to be connected to a passenger boarding bridge.
The unlock waits until you are about 1 km from the airport.
The trophy is hidden, and it is not the story mission VCIA Takedown.

TheGamer says you can take big and small planes from Vice City International if you stay clear of security, and that it is no longer an instant five-star zone. GameRant's fighter-jet spot at Mile Zero is a different theft.

trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge, not one parked on the apron. [1][11] Gates E3 and E4 are the easy pair. [1][14] Take off and fly about a kilometre before the hidden bronze pops. [1][11]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.summary: Steal a Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island, and fire on the guards until the bronze pops.

steps.t: Save, then go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County, the island at the southwest edge.
The tanks sit in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the southeast entrance.
Get in and shoot enemies until the hidden bronze unlocks.
The base is open after Jason's first mission, but a five-star response and extra tanks show up if you linger on the runway, so save and leave fast.

claims.t: The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, which Output Lag places on Goose Key.
Getting in is not enough on PowerPyx's account; you fire until it pops.
The trophy is hidden.
TheGamer tells ordinary pilots to skip Mile Zero because the garrison stays dangerous late. Rock Paper Shotgun's Rhino cheat cannot stand in: using any cheat turns trophies off until you reload.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot until the hidden bronze pops. [1][11] The tanks are in the south of the base. [1] Save first. [11]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.summary: After Yasmani's jewelry jobs give you the Snap Gun, enter a jewelry store by the back door, empty the safe, and leave unseen.

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. That unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry stores.
At the back door, use the Snap Gun. Kicking the door sets off the alarm.
Read the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, kill the cameras and shut off the alarm, then leave.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the spot the guides name. Reload if you are seen.

claims.t: Jewelry stores unlock after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, about halfway through Chapter 3.
100% wants 34 of 35 smash-and-grabs fully looted, including the back-room safe.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun. [1][2] Use it on the back door, loot the safe, and kill the cameras. Kicking the door fails the attempt. [1][11][14] Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the named target. [1][14]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.summary: After the Chapter 4 cafe job, tail security vans into large banks and escape five vaults. 100% wants all eight.

steps.t: Play That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4. It teaches the van-tail and counts as your first vault.
Buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 after his earlier jobs, follow the purple van, and enter while the guard has the vault open.
Bring your partner and hand off a bag when you are full. You cannot carry the whole take alone.
Escape the four stars. A bike through traffic, then a vehicle swap, is the method PowerPyx gives. Repeat until five vaults are done.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 5. There are 8 large-bank vaults, all required for 100%.
A single large bank can pay up to about $205,000.
The silver is visible, and the jobs remain after the story.

trophies.guide: Rob and escape 5 bank vaults. PlayStation tracks 5. [13] The Chapter 4 job That's Where The Money Is teaches the van tail and counts as the first. [1][2] Bring your partner, because you cannot carry every bag. [1][14] 100% wants all 8, and one vault can pay about $205,000. [1][2]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.summary: The Chapter 4 vault tutorial counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also blow a truck's rear door earlier, then leave the red heat zone.

steps.t: Play That's Where The Money Is. Tailing the van into a large bank and robbing the vault counts as this bronze.
To do it sooner, block a van, stick a bomb on the rear doors, and blow them. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his Chapter 3 jobs.
Leave the red heat zone. The flashing search ring is not enough.
The getaway is finished only when you drive clear of the red-shaded district. Flashing search rings are the searching state, not a cleared escape.

claims.t: The vault tutorial counts as the armored-truck robbery if you then leave the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.
The earlier bomb method uses Yasmani's sticky bombs, unlocked from his Chapter 3 jobs.
The bronze is visible, and the pop waits until you leave the red heat zone.
MetaForge lists That's Where The Money Is as a Chapter 4 optional, and Rock Paper Shotgun says the eight vaults stay locked until that cafe wait.

trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and leave the red heat zone, or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. [11][14][25] The Chapter 4 vault tutorial counts, and so does blowing a van's rear doors with Yasmani's sticky bombs. [1][25] Clearing only the flashing search area is not enough. [11][14]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.summary: PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Fly a plane over the black fog until the whole map is clear.

steps.t: Steal a plane and fly over every black patch on the map until the fog is gone.
Watch the trophy counter. PlayStation tracks 52 areas, which is the figure the list uses for all of Leonida.
Do this before a long collectible sweep. Unfogging also reveals activity and robbery icons.
The map is not chapter-locked the way older games were. A plane from the Port Gellhorn strip, or from the Southwind entrance near the Keys, can start the fog clear once you have one.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 52.
Clearing the map fog, fastest by plane, is how both PowerPyx and GTABase describe the requirement.
The bronze is visible.
TheGamer says the map is open from the start, so this exploration bronze is not chapter-gated. Rock Paper Shotgun separately locks a weather cheat behind revealing every region.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PlayStation tracks 52 areas. [13] Fly a plane over the black fog until the map is clear. [1][25] That also reveals the activity and robbery icons you will need later. [1][2]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.summary: Rob one fully looted illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. 100% wants all 39 sites.

steps.t: Step into a site to mark it. Yellow icons stay on the map. Progress, Gangs, shows which group still has zero completed.
Loot every key valuable, including the safe. Killing the guards is not enough. Codes are written on site or on a downed guard.
Cover Kingfishers, Kolts & Associates, M7, La Polilla Negra, Final Chapter, San4San, PTT Youngin$, the Guardia Brothers, and Other Criminals.
Sell narcotics to Tyrone from Chapter 3 if you can. Early fences pay less and some disappear.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 9 gangs. KeenGamer's operation counts add up to 39.
100% wants all 39 operations, so this bronze pops on the way.
A missed valuable can be grabbed when the site respawns. The Ultimate Edition extra PTT site is not one of the 39.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. PlayStation tracks 9. [6][13] A site only counts when every key valuable, including the safe, is taken. [2][6] There are 39 operations, all required for 100%, and they respawn if you miss something. [1][2][6] The bronze is visible. [14]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.summary: PowerPyx says buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it by the bar. Other launch lists still call the trigger unconfirmed.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
If that does not pop, stop. KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase still say the exact trigger is unconfirmed.
If the Apple Martini does not pop, stop experimenting. Rock Paper Shotgun and Fextralife reprint the Ocean Beach cocktail line and still name no bar and no drink.

claims.t: The trophy is hidden.
PowerPyx gives a specific bar and a specific drink.
KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase all say the exact cocktail trigger was not confirmed when they published.
Rock Paper Shotgun rates it a hidden 5 G bronze. Fextralife reprints the same Ocean Beach description and also gives no drink.

disputes.q: Is the Apple Martini at Ocean View Rooftop Bar confirmed?

a.t: PowerPyx says buy an Apple Martini there and drink it beside the bar.

b.t: KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase say the exact trigger is still unconfirmed. GTABase only restates the description. Rock Paper Shotgun and Fextralife reprint the cocktail line and still name no bar and no drink.

disputes.call: Try the Apple Martini first. It is the only specific method on record, and it is cheap to test.

trophies.guide: Try an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, drunk beside the bar. That is PowerPyx's method. [1] KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase still call the exact trigger unconfirmed. [5][11][25] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.summary: After the key cloner, PowerPyx says drive the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom out through the glass. Other lists still call that unconfirmed.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS so you have the key cloner.
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and hack the blue Banshee.
Drive straight through the front window and keep going down the street. The pop is slightly delayed, and PowerPyx says other cars in that showroom do not count.

claims.t: The key cloner arrives in the Chapter 3 Zorrusso mission.
PowerPyx says only the blue Banshee in that showroom works, as a nod to an older Banshee.
KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase still list the exact showroom method as unconfirmed.
The trophy is hidden.

disputes.q: Is the blue Banshee through the showroom window the real trigger?

a.t: PowerPyx says that specific car, after the key cloner, driven through the glass.

b.t: KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase say the exact steps were still unconfirmed at launch. GTABase only restates the showroom-window description.

disputes.call: Do the Banshee exit once you have the cloner. It is the only concrete method published, and the car is still there afterward if it fails.

trophies.guide: After the key cloner, hack the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window. [1][3] PowerPyx says other cars there do not count. [1] KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase still call the exact method unconfirmed. [5][11][25] The bronze is hidden. [14]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.summary: Take all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then escape. You can return later for anything you left.

steps.t: In Chapter 2, play the optional Hit Kingpin Bowling, or go to the alley in Port Gellhorn once it is marked.
Take the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway.
Open the safe with code 0300 or a sticky bomb, then escape the police. The bronze waits for the escape.
If you miss an item, wait for the robbery icon to return and grab the rest. Earlier pieces still count.

claims.t: Kingpin Bowling is a Kolts & Associates illegal operation in Port Gellhorn.
PowerPyx gives the safe code 0300 as an alternative to blowing it.
The trophy is not missable, because the site respawns.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Clear the three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then escape. [1][6][14] PowerPyx places a watch in the southeast office, a unique shotgun on the northeast table, and a safe that takes 0300 or a bomb. [1] Missed items can be taken on a later visit. [1][14] The bronze is hidden. [11][25]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.summary: Max Strength on Jason and Lucia at the same time. Training with your partner called in levels both of them.

steps.t: After Coffee Break, call your partner and buy a gym membership. Filter the map for fitness clubs.
Work out with one character. The partner trains alongside you, so both bars move.
Check Strength on each character under the Jason and Lucia menu. The hidden bronze pops when both are maxed together.
A body-armor cheat is gated on 100 workouts, which is a separate counter from the paired Strength bars this bronze wants.

claims.t: You cannot start the paired workouts until switching is unlocked, which the guides place at Coffee Break or just after Breakfast Run.
After the story you can also train at home.
The trophy is hidden.
Eurogamer's August preview already showed partner weightlifting, and warned that list could change. Rock Paper Shotgun's post-launch list still keeps the hidden partnership description.

trophies.guide: Max Strength on both Jason and Lucia at once. [1][11] Call your partner to a gym after Coffee Break so the idle character trains too. [1][14][21] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.summary: PlayStation wants 500 actions that move your criminal profile. Robberies and fights fill it, so a dedicated grind is a last resort.

steps.t: Turn on criminal-profile notifications so the demon-face popup shows when an action counts.
Play normally. Stealth finishes, limb shots, kills and escapes all move the counter.
If it is still short at the end, run over pedestrians. Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes police shoot sooner.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 500.
PowerPyx lists five profile tones: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Irredeemable is permanent.
The trophy is hidden.

trophies.guide: Log 500 criminal-profile actions. PlayStation tracks 500. [9][13] Robberies and fights fill it during a normal platinum run. [1][11] Turn the profile notifications on, and do not grind your way into the permanent Irredeemable status. [1][19] The bronze is hidden. [14][25]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.summary: After Credit Check, return as Lucia alone to the Little Cuba payday-loan shop from the prologue, rob it, and escape on foot.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 so payday-loan jobs and the dye-pack jammer are unlocked.
Go alone as Lucia, without Jason, to the payday-loan shop in Little Cuba.
Threaten the teller, deal with security, break into the back, and empty the three cash drawers.
Run out of the search area on foot. Driving away does not pop it. The unlock is delayed.

claims.t: PowerPyx ties the shop to the prologue robbery and says the earliest attempt is after Credit Check.
KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase still listed the exact method as unconfirmed.
The trophy is hidden.

disputes.q: Is the second Little Cuba payday-loan robbery, escaped on foot, confirmed?

a.t: PowerPyx gives that exact return visit, as Lucia alone, after Credit Check.

b.t: KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase say the unlock method was unconfirmed at launch. GTABase only restates the description.

disputes.call: Do the on-foot return once payday loans are open. It matches the description, and the shop is not a one-time site.

trophies.guide: After Credit Check, rob the Little Cuba payday-loan shop again as Lucia alone, then escape on foot. [1][2] Driving away does not count, on PowerPyx's account. [1] KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase had not confirmed that method at launch. [5][11][25] The bronze is hidden. [14]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.summary: PowerPyx unlocks it with a night UFO encounter northwest of the Starlet Motel. Output Lag still treats that, and a Crosstown safe code, as unconfirmed leads.

steps.t: After 2 a.m., go alone to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car. If it is not there, drive away and come back. The spawn is not guaranteed.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the blue light, talk to the woman who is dropped, and walk her back to the car.
If that never appears, Output Lag's other lead is a one-time glowing stairwell room east of the Pawn & Gun in Crosstown, whose code opens a ground-floor safe.

claims.t: PowerPyx says the UFO is night-only, after 2 a.m., and solo.
Output Lag and GTABase both say the exact trigger was unconfirmed when they checked. GTABase only expects a strange event.
MyGTA's easter-egg page records a separate Bigfoot disagreement and does not settle this trophy.
The trophy is hidden.

disputes.q: Does the Kelly County UFO encounter pop this bronze?

a.t: PowerPyx says completing that night encounter, and walking the abducted woman back to her car, unlocks it.

b.t: Output Lag lists the UFO and a Crosstown code as unconfirmed leads. GTABase also says the exact steps are not confirmed yet.

disputes.call: Try the UFO first, more than once if the blinking car is missing. Note the Crosstown code if you see it, because Output Lag says that room may appear only once.

trophies.guide: Try the night UFO northwest of the Starlet Motel, alone, after 2 a.m. PowerPyx says walking the dropped woman back to her car pops the hidden bronze. [1][14] Output Lag and GTABase still treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed, so repeat the drive if the blinking car is absent and write down any Crosstown code you see. [11][25]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.summary: PowerPyx says kick 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds. Launch lists that had not confirmed a method should be treated as the dissent, not as a second recipe.

steps.t: Get on any bike in a crowd, such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square. PowerPyx wants 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.
If it does not pop, do not invent a bowling-alley melee. KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase had not confirmed a count, and GTABase only reads the description as a melee hit from a vehicle.
Do not switch to a bowling-alley melee. Rock Paper Shotgun and Fextralife keep that alley as a separate hidden trophy.

claims.t: PowerPyx's count is 10 kicks in 60 seconds from a bike.
GTABase reads the description as a melee attack from a vehicle, which fits a bike kick, but does not confirm a count.
The trophy is hidden.
Rock Paper Shotgun and Fextralife print the melee drive-by description and still give no count, no timer and no weapon, so they do not confirm the 10-kick recipe.

disputes.q: Is the 10-kick bike method confirmed?

a.t: PowerPyx says kick 10 pedestrians from any bike within 60 seconds, in a crowd.

b.t: KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase say the precise method was still unconfirmed at launch. Rock Paper Shotgun and Fextralife reprint the melee drive-by line and still give no count.

disputes.call: Try the timed bike kicks. It matches the description, and nothing else specific has been published.

trophies.guide: From a bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds in a crowd such as Ocean Beach. That is PowerPyx's method. [1] GTABase agrees the description means a melee hit from a vehicle, but KeenGamer, Output Lag and GTABase had not confirmed the 10-kick count. [5][11][25] The bronze is hidden. [14]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.summary: After the dye-pack jammer, fence $250,000 in marked bills across as many bank and payday-loan jobs as you need. One large vault can cover most of it.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check so you have the dye-pack jammer. Without it, marked bills cannot be fenced.
Rob banks and payday loans, then sell the bills to a fence. Yasmani pays the most of the contacts PowerPyx names.
The total adds up across trips. You do not need $250,000 in one bag.
After That's Where The Money Is, one large vault can pay up to about $205,000, so the rest is a short follow-up.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 250000.
The same $250,000 marked-bills line is on the 100% checklist.
IGN's unfinished 100% table shows $100,000 for marked bills, which does not match the trophy or the other checklists.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Fence $250,000 in marked bills. PlayStation tracks 250000. [13] Credit Check unlocks the dye-pack jammer, and banks plus payday loans are the source. [1][2] The total adds across sales, and one late vault can cover most of it. [1][11] The same figure is on the 100% list. [2][5]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.summary: Spend $100,000 in any mix of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they cost the most.

steps.t: Buy guns, vehicle mods and tattoos until the counter hits $100,000. Clothes and hair count too, they are just slower.
Do not spend the garage fund first if Little Boxes is still open. The eight garages cost about $160,000 together.
The total is cumulative across every shop type.
Eurogamer's 100% table never mentions the $100,000 shop spend, so clearing that page is not the same as finishing this bronze.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 100000.
PowerPyx lists mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, Ammu-Nation, clothes, footwear, salons, tattoos and electronics as spending that counts.
The bronze is visible.
Rock Paper Shotgun lists this as a visible 15 G bronze and keeps the published $100,000 shop total. Fextralife prints the same description.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops. PlayStation tracks 100000. [13] Guns, mods and tattoos are the fastest. [1][11] Hold back about $160,000 if you still need the eight garages. [1][14]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.summary: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app. The four story garages do not count, and the eight cost about $160,000.

steps.t: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2. The real-estate app installs after that mission.
Buy all eight purchasable garages through the phone. Ignore the four the story gives you.
Fund them with robberies, especially once Chapter 3 and 4 open the higher-value jobs. Do this before you blow the cash on clothes.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 8.
PowerPyx and games.gg say the eight cost about $160,000 in total, and the four story garages do not count.
The app unlocks after Daily Driver.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app. PlayStation tracks 8. [9][13] The app unlocks after Daily Driver, the eight cost about $160,000, and the four story garages do not count. [1][11][14]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.summary: After Moses installs Scooter Bros, register 10 stolen vehicles. You need garage slots first, and cheap cars keep the fee down.

steps.t: Finish Moses in Chapter 2 so the Scooter Bros app is on the phone.
Buy garages first. Each one adds parking slots, and you cannot register a car without a free space.
At the start, take untracked cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register.
From Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at a Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes if you want to save money.

claims.t: PlayStation tracks 10.
Moses only takes untracked cars at first. Pay 'n' Spray registration of standard-tracker cars comes in Chapter 3.
Registration costs money, so low-end cars are the cheap route.
The bronze is visible.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in Scooter Bros. PlayStation tracks 10. [13] The app arrives with the Chapter 2 Moses mission, and you need garage space from the real-estate app first. [1][11][14] Early on, only untracked cars can be resprayed and registered at Moses. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray takes standard-tracker cars. [1][11] Cheap cars keep the fee down. [1][14]
